================================================================================
CQL: dollar quotes and slash comments
================================================================================

select $$a;b$$ // c; d
from t /* e; */ -- f;
;
select `g;h`;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (dollar_string)
    (comment)
    (comment)
    (comment))
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
CQL: a batch
================================================================================

BEGIN BATCH
  INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (:a);
APPLY BATCH;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))
